title: Silver or bronze?
hook: Would second place always feel better than third?

knows: basic arithmetic and reading a small table
doesNotKnow: Distinguish absolute rank from the comparison outcome someone may imagine.

misconception: The quantities in this case can be combined without checking their reference, denominator, or information boundary.
objective: Distinguish absolute rank from the comparison outcome someone may imagine.
keyState: Both complete computed cases are visible as retained observations; the question-case picture survives Reset.

claims.text: A toy silver medalist has actual rank two and compares with rank one. What is reference rank minus actual rank? Toy inputs A=[2, 1]; B=[3, 4].
claims.source: Local explicit hypothetical assumptions in spec.ts and model.ts; not participant measurements.

claims.text: Computed results: [[-1, 2, 1], [1, 3, 4]]. Labels: Reference−actual, Actual rank, Reference rank.
claims.source: compute() in the lesson-local model.ts; finite numeric operations over the explicit inputs.

claims.text: Absolute rank and the direction of a reference comparison are distinct. The bronze case has a worse actual rank but a favorable comparison against fourth. These numbers describe the toy reference rule, not a measured emotion.
claims.source: The two controlled cases in spec.ts; scope limited to these toy inputs and displayed model rule.

claims.text: A new toy case uses Actual rank=3, Compared rank=4. What is Reference−actual? Answer: 1.
claims.source: compute() applied to the contrasting new input case; source list is an idea pointer only.

recall.question: A new toy case uses Actual rank=3, Compared rank=4. What is Reference−actual?
recall.why: Applying the stated toy rule to the new inputs gives 1. The result depends on these assumptions; it is not a universal behavioral response.

sourceProvenance.text: Olympic bronze medalists looked happier than silver medalists (Medvec, Madey & Gilovich, 1995).
sourceProvenance.caveat: Original list says figures are approximate and papers were not individually rechecked. No empirical source is verified by this build.

meaningfulDifference: Distinguish absolute rank from the comparison outcome someone may imagine.
